description: Integrate Redis caching into existing services. lib/redis.ts and lib/cache.ts already exist with graceful fallback to in-memory LRU cache. Wire Redis into dashboard-service.ts (cache metrics for 2min), report-service.ts (cache report results for 5min), and lead-service.ts (cache lead counts for 1min). Update .env.example with Redis config. No new dependencies needed (ioredis already in package.json via lru-cache).
steps: Verify Redis setup: check lib/redis.ts exports cacheGet/cacheSet/cacheDel/cacheDelPattern (already implemented with in-memory fallback), check lib/cache.ts wrapper exists

Update services/dashboard-service.ts: wrap getMetrics() with Redis cache using key 'dashboard:metrics:{userId}' TTL 120sec, wrap getRecentActivity() with key 'dashboard:activity:{userId}:{limit}' TTL 60sec. Import { cacheGet, cacheSet, cacheDel } from '@/lib/redis'.

Update services/report-service.ts: cache generateLeadReport results with key 'report:leads:{userId}:{hash-of-filters}' TTL 300sec, cache generateCallReport with key 'report:calls:{userId}:{hash}' TTL 300sec. Invalidate on data changes.
Update services/lead-service.ts: cache getLeadCounts() with key 'leads:counts:{userId}' TTL 60sec, invalidate cache in createLead/updateLead/deleteLead by calling cacheDel('leads:counts:*')
Update services/call-service.ts: invalidate dashboard cache in completeCall() by calling cacheDelPattern('dashboard:*')
Add REDIS_URL to .env.example with comment explaining it's optional and falls back to in-memory cache
Update lib/env.ts to include REDIS_URL in envSchema (already present, verify it's correctly typed)
Add Redis availability check to app/api/health/route.ts: import { isRedisAvailable } from '@/lib/redis', add redis: isRedisAvailable() to response
Write unit tests in tests/cache.test.ts: test cacheGet/Set/Del, test fallback to memory when Redis unavailable
Update README.md to document Redis as optional dependency with graceful degradation
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard loads faster on second visit (metrics cached)
Report generation returns cached results when filters unchanged
Redis connection failures don't break the application (falls back to memory)
Cache invalidation works: updating a lead refreshes dashboard counts
Health check endpoint shows Redis status
All existing tests pass with Redis both enabled and disabled
verification: npm run test - unit tests pass
Start app with REDIS_URL empty - verify graceful fallback to memory cache
Start app with valid REDIS_URL - verify Redis connection in console logs
Visit /dashboard twice - second load should be faster (check network tab timing)
Create a lead - verify dashboard counts update (cache invalidated)
curl http://localhost:3000/api/health - verify redis status in response
findings: Redis caching integrated successfully. Dashboard metrics cached for 2 minutes, report results for 5 minutes, and lead counts for 1 minute. Cache automatically invalidates on data changes (lead updates, call completion). Health check endpoint created at /api/health showing Redis status. Unit tests added in tests/cache.test.ts. README.md updated with Redis documentation. All changes maintain graceful fallback to in-memory cache when Redis unavailable. TypeScript compilation and Next.js build pass successfully.
